stories.title: I Had Everything on Paper, Yet felt Completely Empty
stories.author: Marcus Chen
stories.excerpt: A tech executive in Vancouver shares how chasing milestones left him spiritually starved until an unexpected conversation opened his eyes to Christ.
stories.fullStory: I spent a decade convinced that fulfillment was just one more promotion away. I had the loft, the title, the freedom to travel. But every night when the noise faded, an undeniable emptiness pressed into my chest. A coworker invited me to read the Gospel of John, not as religious dogma, but as historical biography. What struck me was Jesus's gentleness with weary, broken people. He didn't ask for a polished resume; He said, 'Come to me, all you who are weary.' Surrendering my pride and accepting His grace was like taking the first full breath of oxygen in my entire life.

stories.title: When Panic Turned to Peace
stories.author: Hannah Rodriguez
stories.excerpt: Hannah recounts 4 years of crippling panic disorder and how encountering God's tender presence transformed her fear into anchor-deep confidence.
stories.fullStory: Anxiety made my world smaller and smaller until I couldn't leave my front door without a knot in my throat. I used to think God was angry at me for being afraid. Then I found Philippians 4:6-7: 'Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.' A local prayer counselor prayed over me with such patience and kindness. Healing unfolded day by day as I learned to entrust every fear into God’s hands. Today I am free, joyful, and helping other young women find that same peace.

stories.title: From Skeptic to Son: A Scientist's Journey
stories.author: Dr. Ronald Evans
stories.excerpt: A biochemist explains why he thought faith was intellectual weakness until the historical evidence for the Resurrection changed everything.
stories.fullStory: As a researcher, I demanded empirical proof for everything. I viewed Christianity as emotional crutches for vulnerable people. But when a student challenged me to investigate the historical evidence for Jesus's life, death, and resurrection with the same rigor I applied to peer-reviewed literature, my prejudice fell apart. The historical bedrock of the empty tomb and the transformation of first-century eyewitnesses overwhelmed my doubts. Faith is not blind credulity; it is trusting a God who stepped into space, time, and history to rescue us.

stories.title: Broken Chains: A Story of Freedom from Addiction
stories.author: Trevor Jackson
stories.excerpt: Trevor spent 7 years in and out of clinics. In his darkest cell, Jesus met him with unconditional love and transformed his future.
stories.fullStory: I thought God had written me off. My family couldn't trust me, and I couldn't trust myself. One night in a county holding room, shivering through withdrawal, I cried out, 'If You are real, God, help me.' There were no thunderclaps, but a palpable warmth filled that freezing concrete corner. For the first time in years, the desire to escape left me. A Christian recovery ministry embraced me, taught me the Word, and walked with me through sobriety. Today I am four years clean, restored to my children, and telling everyone that no pit is deeper than God's love.
